addProduct: INSERT INTO products(code, name, category, minimum) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(code) DO NOTHING RETURNING code
catalog: SELECT * FROM inventory ORDER BY name COLLATE NOCASE, code
recent: SELECT m.id, m.code, p.name, m.kind, m.quantity, m.reason, m.created_at FROM movements m JOIN products p ON p.code = m.code ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 100
statistics: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products, COALESCE(SUM(stock),0) AS units, COALESCE(SUM(stock <= minimum),0) AS alerts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM movements) AS movements FROM inventory
addMovement: INSERT INTO movements(code, kind, quantity, reason) SELECT code, ?, ?, ? FROM inventory WHERE code = ? AND (? = 'entrada' OR stock >= ?) RETURNING id
